7	@MainActor
8	final class NotificationManager: ObservableObject {
9	    static let shared = NotificationManager()
10	
11	    /// Whether the user has granted notification permission.
12	    @Published private(set) var isAuthorized = false
13	
14	    /// Media to navigate to when a notification is tapped.
15	    @Published var pendingMediaId: Int?
16	    @Published var pendingMediaType: MediaType?
17	
18	    /// UserDefaults key for user's notification toggle.
19	    private static let notificationsEnabledKey = "notificationsEnabled"
20	
21	    /// UserDefaults key for the last time the user opened the app.
22	    private static let lastOpenedDateKey = "lastOpenedDate"
23	
24	    /// The last time the user brought the app to the foreground.
25	    /// Used as the baseline for badge count calculation. Defaults to `.distantPast`
26	    /// so that first-launch users see badges for all pending notifications.
27	    var lastOpenedDate: Date {
28	        get {
29	            let interval = UserDefaults.standard.double(forKey: Self.lastOpenedDateKey)
30	            return interval > 0 ? Date(timeIntervalSince1970: interval) : .distantPast
31	        }
32	        set {
33	            UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue.timeIntervalSince1970, forKey: Self.lastOpenedDateKey)
34	        }
35	    }
36	
37	    /// Whether the user has enabled notifications in app settings.
38	    var notificationsEnabled: Bool {
39	        get { UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: Self.notificationsEnabledKey) }
40	        set { UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue, forKey: Self.notificationsEnabledKey) }
41	    }

43	    private init() {
44	        Task { await refreshAuthorizationStatus() }
45	    }

48	
49	    /// Requests notification permission from the user.
50	    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {
51	        do {
52	            let granted = try await UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
53	                .requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .badge, .sound])
54	            isAuthorized = granted
55	            if granted {
56	                notificationsEnabled = true
57	            }
58	            return granted
59	        } catch {
60	            return false
61	        }
62	    }

65	    func requestPermissionIfNeeded() async {
66	        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
67	        guard settings.authorizationStatus == .notDetermined else { return }
68	        _ = await requestPermission()

84	    /// Reschedules episode notifications for all TV shows with upcoming episodes.
85	    /// Badge values are based on episodes airing after `lastOpenedDate`, not on
86	    /// Notification Center state. This prevents badge inflation across scheduling runs.
87	    func rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: [WatchlistItem]) async {
88	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
89	
90	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
91	
92	        // Remove all existing episode notifications
93	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
94	        let episodeIds = pendingRequests
95	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
96	            .map(\.identifier)
97	        center.removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: episodeIds)
98	
99	        // Build content for all eligible episodes
100	        var contentItems: [(content: NotificationContent, airDate: Date)] = []
101	        for item in items where item.isTVShow {
102	            guard let airDate = item.nextEpisodeDate else { continue }
103	
104	            guard let content = NotificationContentBuilder.episodeNotification(
105	                mediaId: item.mediaId,
106	                title: item.title,
107	                seasonNumber: item.nextSeasonNumber,
108	                episodeNumber: item.nextEpisodeNumber,
109	                episodeName: item.nextEpisodeName,
110	                airDate: airDate
111	            ) else { continue }
112	
113	            contentItems.append((content, airDate))
114	        }
115	
116	        // Schedule chronologically so badge values (1, 2, 3...) match air order
117	        let sortedItems = contentItems.sorted { $0.airDate < $1.airDate }
118	        var badgeOffset = 0
119	        for (content, airDate) in sortedItems {
120	            if airDate > lastOpenedDate {
121	                badgeOffset += 1
122	                await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: badgeOffset)
123	            } else {
124	                await scheduleNotification(content)
125	            }
126	        }
127	    }

135	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }

165	    private func scheduleNotification(_ content: NotificationContent, badgeCount: Int? = nil) async {
166	        let notificationContent = UNMutableNotificationContent()
167	        notificationContent.title = content.title
168	        notificationContent.body = content.body
169	        notificationContent.categoryIdentifier = content.categoryIdentifier
170	        notificationContent.threadIdentifier = content.threadIdentifier
171	        notificationContent.sound = .default
172	        notificationContent.userInfo = [

175	        ]

177	        if let badgeCount {

181	        // Create trigger
182	        let trigger: UNNotificationTrigger?
183	        if let triggerDate = content.triggerDate {
184	            let components = Calendar.current.dateComponents(
185	                [.year, .month, .day, .hour, .minute],
186	                from: triggerDate

188	            trigger = UNCalendarNotificationTrigger(dateMatching: components, repeats: false)

13

16	    // MARK: - Registration
17	
18	    /// Registers the background task with the system.
19	    /// Must be called before the end of `application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)`.
20	    func registerTasks() {
21	        BGTaskScheduler.shared.register(
22	            forTaskWithIdentifier: Self.availabilityCheckIdentifier,
23	            using: nil
24	        ) { task in
25	            guard let refreshTask = task as? BGAppRefreshTask else { return }
26	            Task { @MainActor in
27	                await self.handleAvailabilityCheck(task: refreshTask)
28	            }
29	        }
30	    }
31	
32	    /// Schedules the next background refresh.
33	    func scheduleAvailabilityCheck() {
34	        let request = BGAppRefreshTaskRequest(identifier: Self.availabilityCheckIdentifier)
35	        // Request no earlier than 2 hours from now
36	        request.earliestBeginDate = Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: 2 * 60 * 60)
37	
38	        do {
39	            try BGTaskScheduler.shared.submit(request)
40	        } catch {
41	            // Non-fatal — iOS may reject scheduling
42	        }
43	    }
44	
45	    // MARK: - Task Handling
46	
47	    /// Handles the background availability check task.
48	    private func handleAvailabilityCheck(task: BGAppRefreshTask) async {
49	        // Schedule the next check before starting work
50	        scheduleAvailabilityCheck()
51	
52	        // Only check if premium and notifications enabled
53	        guard NotificationManager.shared.shouldScheduleNotifications() else {
54	            task.setTaskCompleted(success: true)
55	            return
56	        }
57	
58	        guard let tmdbService = try? TMDBService() else {
59	            task.setTaskCompleted(success: false)
60	            return
61	        }
62	
63	        let userServiceIDs = UserServicesManager.shared.selectedServiceIDs
64	        guard !userServiceIDs.isEmpty else {
65	            task.setTaskCompleted(success: true)
66	            return
67	        }
68	
69	        // Set up expiration handler
70	        task.expirationHandler = {
71	            // Task ran out of time — will try again next cycle
72	        }
73	
74	        do {
75	            // Create a model container to access watchlist data
76	            let schema = Schema([WatchlistItem.self])
77	            let config = ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, isStoredInMemoryOnly: false, cloudKitDatabase: .none)
78	            let container = try ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: [config])
79	            let context = ModelContext(container)
80	
81	            // Fetch movies that haven't been notified yet
82	            let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchlistItem>(
83	                predicate: #Predicate<WatchlistItem> {
84	                    $0.hasNotifiedAvailability == false
85	                }
86	            )
87	            let items = (try? context.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
88	            let movies = items.filter { $0.isMovie }
89	
90	            // Check each movie's availability
91	            for movie in movies {
92	                let media = movie.toMedia()
93	
94	                do {
95	                    let availability = try await tmdbService.getWatchProviders(for: media)
96	                    let streamingProviders = availability.flatrate
97	
98	                    if let serviceName = NotificationContentBuilder.matchingServiceName(
99	                        providers: streamingProviders,
100	                        userServiceIDs: userServiceIDs
101	                    ) {
102	                        // Match found — notify and mark
103	                        await NotificationManager.shared.notifyMovieAvailable(
104	                            item: movie,
105	                            serviceName: serviceName
106	                        )
107	                        movie.hasNotifiedAvailability = true
108	                    }
109	                } catch {
110	                    // Skip this movie, try next
111	                    continue
112	                }
113	            }
114	
115	            // Also reschedule episode notifications
116	            let allItems = (try? context.fetch(FetchDescriptor<WatchlistItem>())) ?? []
117	            await NotificationManager.shared.rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: allItems)
118	
119	            try? context.save()
120	            task.setTaskCompleted(success: true)
121	        } catch {
122	            task.setTaskCompleted(success: false)
123	        }
124	    }

4	public struct WatchlistRefreshPolicy: Sendable {
5	    /// Minimum hours between automatic refreshes.
6	    public let refreshIntervalHours: Int

8	    /// Creates a refresh policy with the given interval.
9	    /// - Parameter refreshIntervalHours: Hours between refreshes. Defaults to 24.
10	    public init(refreshIntervalHours: Int = 24) {
11	        self.refreshIntervalHours = refreshIntervalHours
12	    }

14	    /// Determines if a refresh is needed based on the last refresh date.
15	    /// - Parameters:
16	    ///   - lastRefreshDate: The date of the last refresh, or nil if never refreshed.
17	    ///   - currentDate: The current date to compare against.
18	    /// - Returns: True if refresh is needed (more than refreshIntervalHours since last refresh).
19	    public func needsRefresh(lastRefreshDate: Date?, currentDate: Date = Date()) -> Bool {
20	        guard let lastRefresh = lastRefreshDate else {
21	            return true
22	        }
23	
24	        let hoursSinceRefresh = Calendar.current.dateComponents(
25	            [.hour],
26	            from: lastRefresh,
27	            to: currentDate
28	        ).hour ?? refreshIntervalHours
29	
30	        return hoursSinceRefresh >= refreshIntervalHours
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Calculates hours until next refresh is allowed.
34	    /// - Parameters:
35	    ///   - lastRefreshDate: The date of the last refresh.
36	    ///   - currentDate: The current date.
37	    /// - Returns: Hours until refresh, or 0 if refresh is due.
